access_note: CAP LTER permits academic, educational and commercial use with citation; requests publication references and no redistribution. Metadata and file listing were publicly visible in the browser. No files downloaded.
description: Arizona State University’s CAP LTER publishes rooftop and surrounding-surface observations for a Tempe residential area. EDI lists thirteen data entities, including LiDAR heights, QuickBird reflectance and classification, rooftop boundaries and day/night MASTER surface-temperature images from July 2011. The portal provides IMG, shapefile and TIFF products freely under custom terms allowing academic, educational and commercial use with acknowledgement, while requesting no redistribution. These spatially limited observations can calibrate roof-temperature and urban-heat simulations at the reported 2.4- and seven-metre imagery resolutions. Scene timing and roof-material interpretation constrain transfer to other neighbourhoods, and the records do not directly measure indoor comfort or energy demand. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: Analysis of rooftop surface temperatures in an urban residential environment
